texts.uiPanel: Show a panel in the Plugins strip
texts.uiMemberBadge: Show a small badge next to user names
texts.uiProfileCard: Add a section to profile cards
texts.uiUserMenu: Add an entry to a user's right-click menu
texts.eventsSelf: Know your own status (mute, deafen, channel)
texts.eventsPresence: Know who joins and leaves your channel
texts.peersMessages: Exchange data with this plugin for other people in your channel
texts.chatSend: Post a chat message for you after you click or type a command
texts.chatSupersedes: Hide its own text line for people who see its card
texts.chatTriggers: Read chat messages that start with its trigger words, such as !poll
texts.netHttp: Talk to a server you choose
texts.secrets: Keep a secret (e.g. an API key) in your system keychain
texts.uiWebview: Show its own web content in a sealed frame (no internet)

explanations.uiPanel: A small panel for this plugin appears in the Plugins strip.
explanations.uiMemberBadge: A small icon can appear next to people's names in the member list.
explanations.uiProfileCard: It can add a section to people's profile cards.
explanations.uiChatCard: It can show its own cards in the chat, for example a poll or a roll result.
explanations.uiUserMenu: It can add an entry to the right-click menu of a user.
explanations.uiDialog: It can open its own window, for example to set something up.
explanations.eventsSelf: It sees whether you are muted or deafened and which channel you are in.
explanations.eventsVoice: It sees when people start and stop talking, never what is said.
explanations.eventsPresence: It sees who joins or leaves your channel.
explanations.eventsChatActivity: It sees that someone is writing, never what they write.
explanations.peersMessages: It can send small amounts of data to this plugin on other people's computers in your channel.
explanations.notify: It can show notifications. They stay quiet during Do Not Disturb.
explanations.randomBytes: It can ask for secure random numbers, for example for dice.
explanations.commands: It can add chat commands that you type, such as /roll.
explanations.chatSend: It can post a chat message in your name, only after you click or type a command.
explanations.chatSupersedes: People who see its card don't also see its plain text line.
explanations.chatTriggers: It reads chat messages that start with its trigger words, such as !poll, and no others.
explanations.netHttp: It can talk to one server you choose, and only to that one.
explanations.secrets: It can keep a secret, such as an API key, in your system keychain.
explanations.uiWebview: It can show its own web content in a sealed frame with no internet access.
